name: Maus Control
author: thenobody0817
description: See every button on your mouse laid out on a diagram, with leader lines to what each one does, and rebind them to any shortcut. Tune pointer sensitivity per mouse — acceleration profile, declared sensor DPI, and named presets you can put on a thumb button — and set the wheel speed. Reads whichever mouse is plugged in and redraws itself to match. Nothing is ever written to the mouse.
